message: No detected input validation: The code accepts a user-uploaded ZIP file and sidebar parameters without any validation of file type, structure, schema, or value ranges beyond Streamlit widget constraints.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is sourced from a local Streamlit file uploader with no remote fetching, so there are no checksums, signed URLs, or authentication mechanisms present.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses folder names as labels but performs no validation of label distributions, comparison against an expected label set, or any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code has no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Although pickle is imported (suggesting serialized model loading may occur elsewhere), no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is visible in this code slice when loading or saving models.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train_test_split and standard metrics (accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, classification_report) are imported, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent evaluation pipelines to guard against metric manipula

No detected input sanitization: The code accepts file uploads and user inputs via Streamlit widgets but performs no shape, range, schema, or malformed-input validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There is no visible code that checks model output probabilities for NaN values, sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML classifier (SVM/NB/LR), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
